items.title:
io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter 1.0.0.54 发布, Spring Boot auto-configuration for REST-in-peace: auto-registers every
		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.

io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter 1.0.0.54 发布, Spring Boot auto-configuration for REST-in-peace: auto-registers every
		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.

items.title: io.github.yuroyami:kitejs-coroutines-jvm 0.3.0 发布, The KiteJS JavaScript engine behind suspending functions. Awaits a JavaScript promise from Kotlin, hands a Deferred to a script as a promise, binds host functions that suspend, and cancels a running script when the calling coroutine is cancelled. The engine runs on a dispatcher that handles one call at a time, as JavaScript itself does.

items.title: io.github.yuroyami:kitejs-rhino-iosarm64 0.3.0 发布, The Rhino JavaScript engine, ported to Kotlin Multiplatform, behind the KiteJS API. Runs ES5.1 and most of ES2015 and later, including classes, async functions, regular expressions, dates, typed arrays, promises, generators, Proxy and BigInt. The parser, the interpreter, the regular expression engine, the date arithmetic and the number formatting are all written in common Kotlin, so a script gives the same answer on Android, iOS, JVM, JavaScript, WebAssembly, Linux, macOS and Windows, with no native code at all.

top.continew.starter:continew-starter 2.17.0 发布, ContiNew Starter（Continue New Starter）基于“约定优于配置”理念，进一步精简常规配置，提供完整的配置解决方案，帮助开发人员更快速地将常用第三方库或工具集成到 Spring Boot Web 应用程序中。
        ContiNew Starter 封装了一系列经过企业实践验证的依赖包（如 MyBatis-Plus、SaToken），可轻松集成到应用中，减少开发人员手动引入依赖及配置的工作量，为 Spring Boot Web 项目的灵活快速构建提供支持。
        ContiNew Starter 源自 ContiNew Admin 后台管理框架项目。随着 ContiNew Admin 的发展，作者发现初学者需要关注过多的脚手架通用基础能力，且在新项目中复用这些能力时存在迁移困难的问题。于是，ContiNew Starter 应运而生，作者在 ContiNew Admin 2.x 版本时，将项目中的通用基础能力进行了抽离并深度优化。这样，无论是在 ContiNew Admin 中使用，还是单独使用这些基础能力，都可以更加轻松。

io.github.jamestoney311:org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.emitter.csv 1.0.12 发布, CSV Report Emitter Plugin for BIRT

BIRT (Business Intelligence Reporting Tools) is an open source Eclipse-based set of reporting and data visualization tools and technologies used to build rich information applications, in particular, web applications based on Java and J2EE.

The CSV Report Emitter plugin for BIRT is an Eclipse based emitter plugin which outputs and displays your BIRT report in CSV Format.

The CSV Report Emitter plugin currently supports emitting a single table within a report design with Column Headers as First Row. This emitter handles Row/Cell level hidden properties while emitting the output.
